body.p: Early in the morning, smallpox and measles arrived in the village. A Russian peasant was standing on a mountain ridge. And they were talking to each other. Smallpox said to measless: "Which hut will you go to?" It says: "I'll go to the hut where a rich person has a child, a girl!" "You say, how will you stick to it?" "How â I'll become a woolly hair, I'll stick! I'll stick to something, and she'll eat me!" Measles said to smallpox: "Which hut will you go to?" I will go to that hut â [where] the merchant lives â he has a child, a son [lit. a man]!" "How will you stick there?" "I'll become a fly! I'll stick to the spoon! And he'll eat me!" That person looks at them, keeps looking at them. The smallpox and measles went to the huts. This person [StN]: caught them both and stuffed them in a chimney.
